subject: A problem trying to download predictor rasters

messages.author: 6dedbe09a10463dd
messages.subject: A problem trying to download predictor rasters
parts:
Hello
I have a problem trying to download predictor rasters masked to background extent
R shows the following error:

Listening on http://127.0.0.1:5788
Warning: running command '"zip" -r9X "C:\Users\DarylD\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpEfZLlx\file11482cb2aeb.zip" "msk_bio1_22.asc" "msk_bio2_22.asc" "msk_bio3_22.asc" "msk_bio4_22.asc" "msk_bio5_22.asc" "msk_bio6_22.asc" "msk_bio7_22.asc" "msk_bio8_22.asc" "msk_bio9_22.asc" "msk_bio10_22.asc" "msk_bio11_22.asc" "msk_bio12_22.asc" "msk_bio13_22.asc" "msk_bio14_22.asc" "msk_bio15_22.asc" "msk_bio16_22.asc" "msk_bio17_22.asc" "msk_bio18_22.asc" "msk_bio19_22.asc" ' had status 127

Do you know how to solve it?
Thanks
Daryl

messages.author: fe049c2835236bb1
messages.subject: Re: A problem trying to download predictor rasters
parts:
Daryl,

This is a problem with the “zip” package. Please try to test just the zip functionality on a zipped file outside of Wallce to confirm this. I got this fixed a while back but don’t recall exactly what I did. There are multiple useful sites to consult, a couple on StackOverflow. If you come to a quick solution, can you please post the answer? Thanks!

Jamie

messages.subject: Re: A problem trying to download predictor rasters
parts:
Hello recently I had problems downloading the Mask predictor rasters by background extent and sample background points.  It was a problem with the zip package.
Jamie suggested that I look for a solution in StackOverflow and fortunately I found a solution there.  I leave the link with the explanation in case someone needs to fix this problem. You just have to install a program called Rtool and during the installation process select an option In selecting additional tasks that says Add Rtools to system path. 
I hope it helps!

Explanation step by step and downlad Rtools:
https://stackoverflow.com/questions/29129681/create-zip-file-error-running-command-had-status-127
